name: University of Innsbruck
summary: Tyrol's general university in an Alpine city; its bachelor's are taught in German, a few partly in English, and need German at B2.

ib.text: Every bachelor's needs German at B2 when you are admitted, shown by a listed certificate such as Goethe or ÖSD; no IB German rule is published. With A2 you can take the university preparation programme first.

notes: International Business and Economics and Atmospheric Sciences are taught in German and English, but both still require a German certificate.
International Business and Economics adds Italian, French or Spanish and a compulsory semester abroad.
